# What we do in the project

1. Create merged panel using stata: "Data file" 
   * Use the same definitions as Michael's codes
   * But include `imp_mic_sic7_3d == 16` industry
   * Done in other do file
   * Save Data file in tsv format to read in R
1. Compute HHI using CIT-IRP5 at various levels: "HHI file"
   * Use CIT-IRP5_2012 HHI in 2012
   * Verify if counts are not erroneous 
1. "Analysis file" = Data file (panel 2009-2022) + HHI file
   * Merge at various levels 
   * Need main place level analysis for larger statistical power
1. Descriptive statistic
1. Hypothesis testing
   * % Employment change = a + b1*FA + b2*HHI + b3*(FA*HHI) + FEs + e
   * Test b3 > 0 labor market power mitigates disemployment impacts
   * Expect b1<0 or b1 = 0
   * No prior for the sign of b2

# Merge data

* FAD (FA, Jobs, Employment) + industry
   * FA is measured at the establishment level
   * `FAD`: Worker level data with establishment level aggregates
   * For estimation, need to aggregate at establishment level, only agriculture &rarr; 
   * `faa`: Collection of first rows of establishment-taxyear
* LS (HHI, WorkersAtEstab) + industry
   * HHI is measured at local market level
   * `LS`: Establishment level data with area level aggregates
   * For estimation, need to aggregate the worker characteristics at establishment level 
* irp5Ma (IRP5), only agriculture
   * All background information at worker level + establishment information

We use:

`faa` (establishment level FAA, Jobs, Employment in agriculture) + `LSMa` (Main Place level HHI in agriculture)

```{r create HHIAgriRowsMainPlaceLevel.qs from HHIAgriRows.qs, eval = F}
LSa <- qread(paste0(pathdata, "HHIAgriRows.qs"), nthreads = 13)
#### table(LSa[, .(Nums = 1:.N, taxyear), 
####  by = c("busprov_geo", "busdistmuni_geo", "buslocmuni_geo", 
####  "busmainplc_geo", "taxrefno")][Nums == 1L, taxyear])
LSMa <- LSa[grepl("Mai", AreaLevel), ]
LSMa[, dJob := c(NA, diff(WorkersAtEstab)), by = .(busprov_geo, busdistmuni_geo, 
  buslocmuni_geo, busmainplc_geo, taxrefno)]
#### jobs are recorded poorly prior to 2013
LSMa[, .(TotalJobs = sum(WorkersAtEstab, na.rm = T)), by = taxyear]
#### Need to set the population == 2012 firms
setorder(LSMa, taxyear, taxrefno)
LSMa[, num := 1:.N, by = .(taxyear, taxrefno)]
LSMa[, ExistedBefore2013 := as.integer(NA)]
LSMa[taxyear < 2013, ExistedBefore2013 := 1L]
LSMa[, ExistedBefore2013 := ExistedBefore2013[!is.na(ExistedBefore2013)][1], 
  by = .(busprov_geo, busdistmuni_geo, buslocmuni_geo, busmainplc_geo, taxrefno)]
LSMa[is.na(ExistedBefore2013), ExistedBefore2013 := 0L]
LSMa[, .(TotalJobs = sum(WorkersAtEstab, na.rm = T)), 
  by = .(ExistedBefore2013, taxyear)][order(ExistedBefore2013, taxyear)]
setkey(LSMa, busprov_geo, busdistmuni_geo, buslocmuni_geo, 
  busmainplc_geo, taxrefno, taxyear)
qsave(LSMa, paste0(pathdata, "HHIAgriRowsMainPlaceLevel.qs"), nthreads = 13)
```

```{r merge faa (base) + LSMa1 gives Lf, eval = F}
#### faa (base) + LSMa1
faa <- qread(paste0(pathdata, "FAOfAgri.qs"), nthreads = 13)
faa[, dJobs := Jobs - mean(Jobs, na.rm = T), by = taxrefno]
faa[, FA0 := FA[1], by = taxrefno]
faa[, Jobs0 := Jobs[1], by = taxrefno]
faa[, rJobs := dJobs/Jobs0]
LSMa <- qread(paste0(pathdata, "HHIAgriRowsMainPlaceLevel.qs"), 
  nthreads = 13)
#### Drop rows with no location info
LSMa1 <- LSMa[busmainplc_geo != "", ]
#### Keep only first row of each establishment
#### Pick 2013 value of establishments for more sample size
#### Keep either 2013 or first entry
#### But if there are two rows, drop the first entry
LSMa1[, num := 1:.N, by = .(busprov_geo, busdistmuni_geo, 
  buslocmuni_geo, busmainplc_geo, taxrefno)]
LSMa2 <- LSMa1[taxyear != 2013 & num == 1L | taxyear == 2013 & num != 1L, ]
setnames(LSMa2, "taxyear", "HHIBaseYear")
#### Lf <- LSMa1[faa, on = c("taxrefno", grepout("bus", colnames(LSMa1)))]
Lf <- LSMa2[faa, on = c("taxrefno", grepout("bus", colnames(LSMa2)))]
Lf[, .(busmainplc_geo, taxrefno, taxyear, Jobs)]
Lf[, num := 1:.N, by = .(busmainplc_geo, taxrefno, taxyear)]
Lf <- Lf[num == 1L, ]
Lf[, ExistedBefore2013 := 0L]
Lf[taxyear < 2013, ExistedBefore2013 := 1L]
Lf[, ExistedBefore2013 := ExistedBefore2013[ExistedBefore2013 == 1L][1], by = taxrefno]
Lf[is.na(ExistedBefore2013), ExistedBefore2013 := 0L]
Lf[, FirstYear2013 := "Before"]
Lf[ExistedBefore2013 == 0L, FirstYear2013 := "Not before"]
Lf[, FirstYear2013 := factor(FirstYear2013)]
Lf[, Sample := "Exposed"]
Lf[FA0 == 0L, Sample := "Unexposed"]
Lf[, Sample := factor(Sample)]
Lf[, AgeSample := "Existed, exposed"]
Lf[grepl("Be", FirstYear2013) & grepl("Un", Sample),
  AgeSample := "Existed, unexposed"]
Lf[grepl("N", FirstYear2013) & grepl("Ex", Sample), 
  AgeSample := "New, exposed"]
Lf[grepl("N", FirstYear2013) & grepl("Un", Sample),
  AgeSample := "New, unexposed"]
Lf[, AgeSample := factor(AgeSample, levels = 
  c("Existed, exposed", "Existed, unexposed", "New, exposed", "New, unexposed"))]
qsave(Lf, paste0(pathdata, "EstSample_Ag.qs"), nthreads = 13)
```

```{r analysis sample descriptive statistics, eval = F}
  rbind(
    ExistedBefore2013 = table(Lf[ExistedBefore2013 == 1L, taxyear]),
    All = table(Lf[, taxyear])
  )
table(LSMa1[num == 1L, HHIBaseYear])
library(tinytable)
agestsum <- Lf[, .(
      TotalJobs          = sum(Jobs, na.rm = T) 
    , TotalSubMWJobs     = sum(NumSubMW, na.rm = T) 
    , TotalEmployees     = sum(Employees, na.rm = T) 
    , TotalSubMWWorkers  = sum(NumSubMWe, na.rm = T) 
    , TotalFirmsWithEmp  = sum(Employees>0, na.rm = T) 
    , TotalAffectedFirms = sum(NumSubMWe>0, na.rm = T) 
    ), 
    by = .(taxyear)
    ][, .(
      taxyear, 
      TotalJobs, TotalSubMWJobs, TotalEmployees, TotalSubMWWorkers, 
      AggFA = round((TotalSubMWJobs/TotalJobs)*100, 2),
      AggFAe = round((TotalSubMWWorkers/TotalEmployees)*100, 2),
      TotalFirmsWithEmp, TotalAffectedFirms,
      AggFirmFA = round((TotalAffectedFirms/TotalFirmsWithEmp)*100, 2)
    )]
tb.agest <- tt(agestsum, width = 0.8, 
  caption = "Jobs and sub-MW jobs, agriculture, estimation sample")
options(tinytable_format_digits = 2)
tb.agest <- format_tt(tb.agest,
    j = c(2:5, 8:9),
    num_mark_big = " "
  )
tb.agest
```
